name: Chignon
summary: A gathered updo secured low at the nape, with the lengths folded or twisted into a bun.
intro: The low placement defines the shape. The hair is drawn toward the nape and the lengths are tucked or pinned into a compact fold.
A smooth surface gives a clearly defined outline, while a softer chignon lets waves and looser pieces show. Hair that just reaches a low tie may need extra pins to secure shorter layers.

variations.name: Sleek chignon
variations.description: Smoothed sides lead to a neat, compact fold at the nape.

variations.name: Soft chignon
variations.description: A loose twist and visible natural texture give the knot a softer outline.

variations.name: Side chignon
variations.description: The low knot is shifted slightly toward one ear.

consultation.intro: Pick the height and placement first, then agree on whether the part and texture should remain visible.
questions: Should the bun sit centrally or slightly to one side?
Do you want the sides smooth or softly pulled back?
Which short layers should be pinned in or left loose?
consultation.sampleRequest: “I’d like a low chignon at the nape, with the ends tucked in and a soft finish around the sides.”

considerations: Check whether the shortest layers reach the intended placement. Pins can hold pieces that fall short of the tie.
Choose a position where the bun clears your collar or headrest if you plan to wear it all day.
